title: Space used with a choice sequence
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be a finite sequence of choice bits, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. The space used by this run is the sum, over the $k$ work tapes, of the numbers of distinct cells visited on each tape when the machine is run from $c$ using the choices in $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes
A finite sequence of choice bits
A configuration on a fixed input
